heading: Jurisdiction of confiscation proceedings
lead: Such prizes and capture shall be condemned in the district court of the United States having jurisdiction of the amount, or in admiralty in any district in which the same may be seized, or into which they may be taken and proceedings first instituted.

notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: R.S. § 5309 derived from act Aug. 6, 1861, ch. 60, § 2, 12 Stat. 319. Act Mar. 3, 1911, conferred the powers and duties of the former circuit courts upon the district courts.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 1877—Act Feb. 27, 1877, inserted “may” after “any district in which the same”.
